Context: None

Question: When recording peak flow results, within how many litres/minute should the three readings be?

Options: 
A. 70 litres per minute of each other.
B. 50 litres per minute of each other.
C. 30 litres per minute of each other.
D. 10 litres per minute of each other.
E. 100 litres per minute of each other.
F. 60 litres per minute of each other.
G. 20 litres per minute of each other.
H. 80 litres per minute of each other.
I. 40 litres per minute of each other.
J. 90 litres per minute of each other.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
